projects.title: PhiOS
projects.tagline: A sovereign operator shell above PhiKernel for local context, bounded interfaces, reviewable continuity, and deliberate runtime control.
projects.story: PhiOS sits above PhiKernel without duplicating the runtime core. It renders operator-friendly state, composes local workflows, prepares bounded identity, persona, and memory-context packets, exposes capability-gated interfaces, organizes reviewable observatory and archive artifacts, and preserves manual control over writeback, adapter promotion, validation, and rollback.
projects.summary: A verified public repository implementing a local sovereign shell, stable CLI and normalized-runtime integration, optional default-off kernel adapters, primary and shadow comparison, advisory rollout review, additive MCP resources and tools, local observatory and archive surfaces, sessions, curation artifacts, and the context/writeback role used by Agentora mission integration.
projects.see: The PhiOS cover, context-sovereignty lifecycle, kernel adapter promotion gate, architecture and context-boundary briefs, fixed-data Context Sovereignty Workbench, PAT Context Mode, verified public repository, and planned context schema and proof fixtures.
projects.proof: Eight public artifacts are connected. The Workbench deterministically evaluates six bundled synthetic context and rollout scenarios while accepting no personal data, verifying no identity, applying no persona, reading or writing no memory, contacting no PhiOS, PhiKernel, Agentora, MCP, model, filesystem, network, pulse, collaborator, or adapter, and changing no runtime or Archive state.
projects.next: Freeze a portable versioned Context Packet and Writeback Receipt schema, publish a context-sovereignty and capability policy in the PhiOS repository, and run a real local proof suite covering conflict surfacing, privacy exclusion, persona overreach, dissent-preserving writeback, compare-mode isolation, manual promotion, reverse-shadow validation, and rollback.
projects.claimBoundary: PhiOS is a working sovereign operator shell above PhiKernel. This package demonstrates verified architecture and fixed synthetic teaching fixtures; it does not establish operating-system security, privacy certification, legal identity, biological identity, personhood, sentience, consciousness, psychological accuracy, mental-health assessment, medical validity, biological measurement, established physical law, complete or truthful memory, correct persona inference, objective coherence, reliable adapter promotion, correct kernel behavior, production suitability, organizational permission, or successful integration with Agentora, MCP clients, models, workers, or external services. PhiKernel is authoritative only inside its declared software runtime contract. Identity labels and persona settings remain human-declared collaboration context; memory remains sourced and contestable; observatory outputs remain interpretive; writeback and runtime promotion require explicit human review.
